content:
sam: Received a support ticket from @acme-cli — tool calls started failing after we rolled v2.3 canary.

lucy: Error they see is a 400 schema validation error from our endpoint. They pasted the error: `Function call rejected: args did not match schema`.

matt: Can you paste the exact payload they sent? We need to repro.

acme-customer (reported in ticket): We send this body to /v1/generate -> tool call

```json
{
  "model": "redwood-model-v2.3",
  "input": "Find nearest store",
  "tools": ["geo.lookup.v1"],
  "tool_args": {"location": "94107"}
}
```

rita: Ok that `location` should be an object `{ city, postal_code }` for geo.lookup.v1 in v2.3 tool schema. Looks like model selected the tool but populated args as string.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout v2.3 -> 40% traffic -> no alerts

lucy: Repro steps I ran locally with the same payload against hosted-canary: got identical response.

```text
HTTP 400
{"error":"toolcall.schema_mismatch","details":"expected object for field 'location', got string"}
```

matt: Huh. Was this working before the v2.3 canary? Customer says it worked on v2.2.

rita: Model change: v2.3 introduced more aggressive tool selection heuristics. It prefers shorter arg representations — seems to flatten location to a string for some prompts.

sam: So two failure modes: (1) model outputs malformed args, (2) schema validator rejects. We can either relax validator to coerce strings -> object if plausible, or roll back v2.3.

lucy: Coercion feels risky for security and correctness. For now we should rollback the canary and open a regression bug against model selection/serialization.

matt: Support ticket wants a timeline. I'll propose rollback to 0% and hotfix plan: revert model selection change in v2.3 -> release v2.3.1 with stricter serialization tests.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated by @matt -> 1789000350 -> traffic -> 0%

support-bot: Notified customer: "We observed a schema mismatch introduced in our latest canary. Rolling back v2.3 for you; investigating root cause."

rita: I collected sample mismatched outputs; adding to repro gist: https://internal.redwood/gists/issue-1122

sam: Action items: 1) rollback complete, 2) add coercion test + schema fuzzing, 3) add post-canary toolcall regression checks in CI, 4) notify affected customers.

lucy: I'll file the Jira and tag @eng-ml for model serialization fix.

matt: Thanks everyone — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
